title: Mara and the Letter
author: C. M. Underhill
blurb: Coral Ashgrove, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, has spent seven years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must choose which family member gets the last berth before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
